description: List a domain's pages from the inventory with each page's title, description, the title and description that are actually served (after meta rules and saved changes), inbound link count and issues. Filter by section, search text, orphans, pages with issues or trash. Changes nothing. Needs a token; a read-only API key is sufficient and recommended.

domain.description: The connected domain, as a hostname, e.g. example.com.

filter.description: all, orphans, issues or trash. Defaults to all.

limit.description: Pages to return. Defaults to 50, at most 200.

q.description: Only pages whose URL or title contains this text.

section.description: Only pages under this path, e.g. /br/casino.

sort.description: Order by inbound links, fewest or most first.

name: list_pages
title: List pages
